const documents = [
  {
    source: "returns-policy.md",
    content: `
TECHSTORE - RETURNS AND REFUNDS POLICY

Voluntary return period: 30 calendar days from receipt.
This does not limit mandatory consumer rights under applicable local law.

Products should be in good condition, with accessories and original packaging when reasonably possible. Proof of purchase may be requested.

Customers must contact support, provide their order reference and reason for return, and wait for instructions. They should not send products without authorization.

Refunds are reviewed after inspection. Approved refunds are issued to the original payment method. Normal processing takes 5-10 business days after approval, although payment providers may vary.

Damaged or defective products must be reviewed under applicable consumer protection and warranty rules.

Exceptions may include misuse, missing accessories, physical damage unrelated to manufacturing and personalized products. These cases must be reviewed individually.

The AI agent cannot approve refunds or authorize returns. Disputes, defective products, delayed refunds and unclear cases must be escalated to a human representative.
`
  },
  {
    source: "shipping-policy.md",
    content: `
TECHSTORE - SHIPPING POLICY

Standard shipping: estimated delivery within 3-5 business days.
Express shipping: estimated delivery within 1-2 business days.

Delivery estimates begin after order processing and dispatch. They are estimates, not guaranteed dates.

Shipping costs depend on destination, shipping method and order details. The exact cost is displayed during checkout.

Orders are normally processed within 1-2 business days. Processing may take longer during weekends, public holidays or periods of high demand.

Customers receive a tracking link by email after dispatch.

The AI agent has no access to order management or carrier tracking systems. It must never claim to have checked an order.

Delayed, lost, damaged or incomplete deliveries must be reviewed by human support.

Address changes cannot be guaranteed after processing or dispatch.
`
  },
  {
    source: "warranty-policy.md",
    content: `
TECHSTORE - WARRANTY POLICY

Products may be covered by a manufacturer's warranty or applicable consumer protection legislation.

The exact warranty period and conditions depend on the product, manufacturer and applicable law. The AI agent must not invent warranty periods.

Defective products must be reviewed by human support.

A warranty review may require the order reference, product name and model, purchase date, problem description and photographs or videos.

Potential exclusions include accidental damage, improper use, unauthorized modifications and normal wear and tear. These circumstances must be reviewed individually.

The AI agent cannot verify purchases, approve warranty claims, authorize repairs or replacements, or make final eligibility decisions.

Warranty disputes and unclear cases must be escalated.
`
  },
  {
    source: "billing-faq.md",
    content: `
TECHSTORE - BILLING FAQ

Available payment methods are displayed during checkout. The AI agent must not assume that every method is available for every destination or order.

Customers receive an order confirmation email after a successful purchase.

If a customer reports a charge without an order confirmation, human support must review the case.

Invoices and receipts can be requested from customer support. The AI agent cannot generate invoices or access billing records.

For incorrect or duplicate charges, acknowledge the concern and offer human assistance. Never request complete payment card details.

The AI agent cannot verify transactions, determine why a payment failed, approve refunds or modify charges.

Disputed payments, unexpected charges and billing corrections must be escalated.
`
  },
  {
    source: "customer-support-faq.md",
    content: `
TECHSTORE - CUSTOMER SUPPORT FAQ

Customer support assists with orders, deliveries, returns, refunds, warranties, invoices, payments, damaged products and complaints.

The AI agent can provide information from the knowledge base but has no access to individual customer accounts or order records.

Order changes and cancellations must be reviewed by human support. The AI agent must not promise that an action has been completed.

When handling complaints, listen carefully, acknowledge concerns, remain professional and offer human escalation.

If information is unavailable, explain the limitation. Never guess or present general industry practices as official TechStore policies.

Never request passwords, complete payment card numbers, security codes or authentication codes.

Respond in Spanish unless the customer requests another language. Keep answers clear, friendly and concise.

Escalate when a customer requests a person, an issue requires account access, a complaint needs investigation, a decision is required, or information is insufficient.

The AI agent cannot transfer conversations automatically unless an escalation tool is configured.
`
  }
];

return documents.map(doc => ({
  json: {
    text: doc.content,
    source: doc.source
  }
}));
